parts.name: Wing boom-clamp rib

parts.name: Aileron bay false spar (closing web)
parts.notes: 1 mm carbon closing ply bonded over the core aft face behind the rear-spar caps; carries the hinge brackets.

parts.name: Aileron (foam core, carbon skin)
parts.notes: Hot-wire core on template T-HW-AIL (same section for flaps and ailerons), 0.6 mm carbon skin; span 1383 mm; hinge line 0.775 c (behind the rear-spar caps).

parts.name: Aileron actuator (EMA placeholder)
parts.notes: Envelope 200 x 80 x 50 mm, spanwise between the spars; bell-crank and push-rod through the rear-spar web and false spar.

parts.name: Control-surface hinge bracket
parts.notes: 6 mm 6061-T6 plate, 2.5-D; bolted to the false spar through potted inserts, AN3 clevis pin.

parts.name: Wing tip fairing
parts.notes: 2 plies glass over a CNC-machined foam plug (T-PLUG-TIP), bonded to the last core with a 25 mm joggle.

parts.name: Wing root lug, main spar (FEA part P1)
parts.notes: Dimensions of WP F part P1 (fea/parts.py): 12 mm 7075-T6 plate (eye boss 18 mm) 170 x 120 mm, lug 60 mm wide, pin 19.05 mm, 8 x AN5 through the spacer and the spar web; holes drilled through T-DRILL-RF and reamed; lug exits the lower skin through a slot.

parts.name: Root lug spacer, main spar (web to cap edge)
parts.notes: 6061 packer that brings the P1 plate forward of the lower cap so the lug clears the cap; bonded to the web with EA 9394 and clamped by the lug bolts.

parts.name: Fuselage wing-attach clevis, main spar
parts.notes: Machined 7075-T6 (WP F phase 3.2 redesign): cheeks stand directly on the 24 mm bolted plate as a U-channel with a 40 mm flange and a gusset, 6 x AN5 outside the cheeks; the leg bolts (6 x AN4 through potted inserts) to the outer face of the cabin side panel; the clevis sits outside the fuselage OML and is covered by the wing-root fairing F-WRF.

parts.name: Wing attach pin, main spar (3/4 in close-tolerance bolt)
parts.notes: Close-tolerance bolt with castellated nut and safety pin; removed to de-rig the wing.

parts.name: Wing root lug, rear spar (FEA part P1)
parts.notes: Dimensions of WP F part P1 (fea/parts.py): 12 mm 7075-T6 plate (eye boss 14 mm) 170 x 120 mm, lug 60 mm wide, pin 19.05 mm, 8 x AN5 through the spacer and the spar web; holes drilled through T-DRILL-RF and reamed; lug exits the lower skin through a slot.

parts.name: Root lug spacer, rear spar (web to cap edge)

parts.name: Wing attach pin, rear spar (3/4 in close-tolerance bolt)

parts.name: Parachute front hard-point angle (to the main spar aft web)
parts.notes: 6 mm 6061 angle machined from bar, bonded and bolted (4 x AN5) through the aft box web with a backing plate.

parts.name: HV harness run inside the boom (simplified conduit)

parts.name: Coolant line inside the boom (simplified)

parts.name: Cooling pack: radiator, pump, reservoir (placeholder)

parts.notes: Hung under the boom between the two wing clamps; scoop fairing in COOL-FAIR.

parts.name: Cooling pack fairing with inlet
parts.notes: Glass over a CNC foam plug; screwed to the clamp ears with rivnuts.

parts.name: Boom-to-wing saddle clamp, front (main spar)
parts.notes: WP F part P2 geometry (ring wall 12 mm, width 110 mm, pad 150 x 16 mm, 4 x AN6 into potted inserts at the wing spar cap). One-piece 6061-T6 ring slid on from the boom front end, bore abraded, primed and bonded (EA 9394) at its station. See validation/cad: the pad and boom crown sit above the wing lower surface.

parts.name: Boom-to-wing saddle clamp, rear (rear spar), slotted holes
parts.notes: WP F part P2 geometry (ring wall 12 mm, width 110 mm, pad 150 x 16 mm, 4 x AN6 into potted inserts at the wing spar cap). One-piece 6061-T6 ring slid on from the boom front end, bore abraded, primed and bonded (EA 9394) at its station. See validation/cad: the pad and boom crown sit above the wing lower surface. Rear saddle bolt holes slotted 16 mm fore-aft so boom/wing differential strain and tolerance are not forced through the joint (WP F requirement).

parts.name: Pylon boom saddle with pylon socket
parts.notes: Identical at all 8 stations (L/R and fore/aft). Same P2 saddle as the wing clamps (one bore for all), plus a 60 mm deep, 8 mm wall socket for the pylon tube (bonded, 2 x AN4 cross-bolts). The lower ring is scalloped to a 60 mm band and the ring flanks have windows: they remove 11 % (mass_calibration target 30 %); WP F to re-check.

parts.name: Rotor pylon tube 100 x 1.6 mm
parts.notes: 6061-T6 drawn tube (WP F rotor_pylon_section); pylon = boom axis to hub 630 mm; internal bonded sleeves at both ends.

parts.name: Pylon head (P3 stub + isolator flange)
parts.notes: Carries the WP F P3 pylon stub (OD 100, wall 4, 30 mm) with an 8 mm flange for the six isolators; stub bonded over an internal sleeve in the pylon tube; flange windows between the isolator bosses remove 26 % (target 25 %).

parts.name: Motor-plate elastomeric isolators (6 per station)
parts.mass_source: estimate (6 x 60 g sandwich mounts, M8 studs)
parts.notes: Cylindrical rubber-metal sandwich mounts d 38 x 25 mm under the motor plate; tune the vertical/torsional rates to place the mount modes below 0.7 x 1P at hover rpm; snubbing washers limit travel if an isolator fails (WP F to verify).

parts.name: Motor plate (FEA part P3)
parts.notes: WP F P3: R 140 mm, 10 mm 6061-T6, 8 x M8 motor bolts on PCD 180 (confirm on the REB 50 drawing); six isolator studs at PCD 210. The P3 pylon stub is on PY-HEAD below the isolators; the FEA load path now runs through the isolators. Windows and pockets between the bolt circles remove 48 % (target 50 %, FEA MS +2.8).

parts.name: EMRAX face-mount adapter ring
parts.notes: 12 mm 6061-T6 ring: EMRAX stator bolt circle (confirm on the EMRAX 268 drawing) to the P3 motor-plate bolt circle; the motor plate keeps the WP F P3 dimensions.

parts.name: Motor coolant hoses (supply/return, per station)
parts.mass_source: 15 % of the cooling side mass item / 4 stations
parts.notes: 16 mm hoses from the boom manifold up the pylon to the EMRAX coolant ports (liquid-cooled).

parts.name: Lift motor EMRAX 268 MV (axial flux) (placeholder)
parts.notes: Diameter 268.0 mm from the catalog; axial length 91 mm.

parts.name: Lift inverter MGM HBCi 400800 (placeholder)
parts.notes: Envelope assumed (catalog gives no dimensions). It does not fit the 116 mm pylon fairing, so it hangs under the boom below the pylon in INV-POD, on a cold plate strapped to the saddle.

parts.name: Inverter pod fairing (under the boom)
parts.notes: 2 plies glass in FDM-printed half moulds; NACA inlet at the front, outlet at the tail; screwed to the saddle.

parts.name: Pylon fairing (116 x 400 mm)
parts.notes: Faired pylon per design/geometry.json (mast thickness/chord): 2 plies glass laid in FDM-printed half moulds (T-NAC-M*), split on the x-z plane, joined with a 15 mm joggle.
parts.joints: two halves (left/right) bonded on the centre plane

parts.name: Lift rotor CCW (E-PROPS ground-adjustable, placeholder)
parts.notes: D 1850 mm, 2 blades, chord 218 mm, shown stopped at 0 deg azimuth, pitch 10.0 deg; spin counter-clockwise seen from above.

parts.name: Lift rotor CW (E-PROPS ground-adjustable, placeholder)

parts.name: Horizontal stabiliser (foam core, carbon skin)
parts.notes: Hot-wire cores on T-HW-HT (constant chord 376 mm) in 3 lengths of <= 1.2 m, spar tunnel cut with a hot tube; 0.6 mm carbon skin; notched at the tail clamps. Section NACA0014 (WP F phase 3.1 / sizing; design/geometry.json still lists naca0014).
parts.joints: cores butt-bonded at 2 span stations; skin continuous

parts.name: Elevator (one piece)
parts.notes: 35 % chord, full span between the booms; 4 hinges.

parts.name: Horizontal-tail spar tube
parts.notes: Roll-wrapped twill tube 50 x 4.84 mm (WP F sizing) cut to length; bonded into the TL-CLAMP sockets.
parts.joints: one piece, 2.4 m stock + bonded internal sleeve at the centre if 96 in stock is used

parts.name: Tail clamp (boom, HT-spar socket, fin-spar socket)
parts.notes: Machined from 6061-T6 block, split on the vertical plane through the boom axis (4 x AN4 above and below the boom); bonded to the boom band BM-BAND; sockets (10 mm wall) bonded and cross-bolted to the spars. Outboard flank windows only (> 20 mm from the sockets) remove 4 %.

parts.name: Ventral fin (fixed part)
parts.notes: Under each boom; chord 454 mm; symmetric section so one part serves both sides; foam core on T-HW-VF, bottom tip with a replaceable UHMW skid strip.

parts.name: Rudder
parts.notes: 35 % chord; 2 hinges; actuator inside the fin.

parts.name: Fin spar tube
parts.notes: 40 x 2 mm roll-wrapped tube, bonded into the TL-CLAMP socket and the fin core.

parts.name: Tail hinge bracket
parts.notes: 6 mm 6061-T6, potted inserts, AN3 pin.

parts.name: Tail surface actuator (EMA placeholder)

parts.name: Gear leg (bent tube, pivoting on the keel)
parts.notes: 3 x 0.095 in (76.2 x 2.41 mm) 6061-T6 US stock tube (WP F minimum gauge 2.0 mm), one bend (radius 152 mm) by a tube shop to T-XT-TEMPL. The leg pivots on the keel saddle and the oleo damper strokes (WP F phase 3: no continuous clamped cross tube). Four identical legs (left = mirror placement).

parts.name: Leg pivot end fitting
parts.notes: 6061 plug bonded and cross-bolted into the leg end; 24 mm eye with a bronze bush on the 20 mm pivot pin.

parts.name: Keel pivot saddle (P4 pad, clevis for the leg pivot)
parts.notes: Bolted to the belly hard points with the WP F P4 pad (160 mm, 16 mm thick, AN6); clevis cheeks carry the 20 mm leg pivot pin; the vertical load goes through the oleo damper.

parts.name: Leg pivot pin (20 mm, 4130)
parts.notes: Shouldered pin, castellated nut, grease nipple.

parts.name: Skid oleo damper (80 mm stroke)
parts.notes: Oleo-pneumatic damper, eye-to-eye 517 mm extended, 80 mm stroke, acting in parallel with the pivoting leg: the leg pivots on the keel and the damper carries and absorbs the landing load (WP F estimated +6 kg for the damped gear). Spherical bearings at both eyes.

parts.name: Damper lower collar on the gear leg
parts.notes: Split 6061 collar, bonded and pinned to the leg; lug for the damper lower eye.

parts.name: Damper upper fitting (fuselage side hard point)
parts.notes: 6061 fitting through the shell onto the cabin side panel (potted inserts, doubler inside); upper damper eye clevis with 12 mm cheeks, 7075-T6 (WP F phases 3.1/3.3).

parts.name: Skid-to-leg clamp
parts.notes: Machined 6061 block, socket for the cross tube (bonded + 2 x AN4), split bore on the skid; end pockets remove 32 % (mass_calibration target 30 %).

parts.name: Skid wear shoe
parts.notes: Replaceable UHMW-PE half-shell, screwed; raises the static ground line by 5 mm (neglected).

parts.name: Cross-tube leg fairing
parts.notes: Glass in an FDM-printed female mould (split to the printer), clamped round the leg with a trailing-edge zip strip.
